confirmed_victim_count.notes: Homicide convictions only. This is deliberately NOT the figure carried in popular accounts. Higher figures belong in attributed_victim_count and claimed_victim_count and must never be conflated with this one.

attributed_victim_count.notes: No single agency-published attribution figure has been located with a documented methodology. Investigations ran across Washington, Utah, Colorado, Idaho, Oregon and Florida with no consolidated official total. Contributors: cite a specific agency document or leave null.

claimed_victim_count.notes: Figure given by Bundy himself in the days before execution, during interviews conducted while he was seeking a stay. Offender self-report obtained under an explicit incentive to prolong proceedings is among the least reliable classes of evidence in this literature. Recorded as a datum ABOUT Bundy's statements, not as a victim count. The widely circulated ranges of '36 to 100' have no traceable methodology and are excluded from this dataset.

family_structure.value: Born to an unmarried mother, Eleanor Louise Cowell; raised in his maternal grandparents' household in Philadelphia before moving to Tacoma, Washington in 1951, where his mother married Johnny Culpepper Bundy.

family_structure.notes: The widely repeated account that Bundy was raised believing his mother was his sister, and that he discovered this in adolescence, rests on his own later statements and on second-hand family accounts. It is plausible but not documented; it is recorded here as reported, not established. Contributors should not upgrade it without a contemporaneous record.

education.value: B.Sc. in psychology, University of Washington, 1972. Subsequent law study at the University of Puget Sound and the University of Utah; did not complete a law degree.

documented_head_injury.notes: No medical documentation of head injury located. The inherited draft asserted an absence of frontal-cortex injury as though it were a finding; absence of a record is not a finding.

enuresis.notes: No documentation located. NOTE: this construct is not a predictor of violence — see the field description in schema/profile.schema.json and Parfitt & Alleyne (2020).

animal_cruelty.notes: No documentation located. Anecdotes circulating in secondary literature (including the frequently repeated story of knives placed around a sleeping relative) derive from a single family recollection given decades after the fact and are not corroborated.

formal_diagnoses.notes: No court-ordered comprehensive psychiatric evaluation producing a settled diagnosis has been located in the trial record. Dorothy Otnow Lewis examined Bundy shortly before execution and reported bipolar features; that assessment is contested and was not a trial finding. The diagnostic labels routinely attached to Bundy in popular accounts — 'antisocial personality disorder', 'fetishistic sexual sadism', 'malignant narcissism' — are commentary, not findings, and are recorded below accordingly.

competency_findings.value: Found competent to stand trial and to waive counsel in the Florida proceedings; competency was raised and litigated on appeal.

psychometric_results.notes: The IQ figure of 124 asserted in the inherited draft could not be traced to an instrument, an administering clinician or a date. Figures between 124 and 136 circulate in secondary literature without attribution. Under this schema a bare IQ number is inadmissible: cite the instrument, the administrator and the date, or leave null.

The relevant structural feature is the access conditions exploited — routine solitary movement through semi-public space with low ambient suspicion — rather than any characteristic of those targeted.

signature_behaviour.notes: Recurrent post-offence conduct is described extensively in the secondary literature, but every account traces to statements Bundy gave in the days before execution while seeking a stay. No scene documentation or post-mortem finding establishing a recurring non-functional element across offences has been retrieved. Under this field's rule that is 'unverified', not 'reported'. Compare offence_behaviour.post_offence_behaviour, which is null for the same reason.

post_offence_behaviour.notes: Accounts of return visits to deposition sites derive from Bundy's own pre-execution statements, given while seeking a stay. Not independently corroborated. Left null rather than recorded from self-report; graphic detail is in any case excluded under ETHICS.md.

motive_classification.notes: Maintainer coding, not a source-attested fact. The framework is cited as the instrument applied, not as authority for this subject's motive. Canter et al. (2004) is cited as the standing methodological caution on typologies of this family. Contributors coding this case differently should record the disagreement rather than overwrite: divergent coding of the same record is a finding. Coded from the sexual element established in the conviction record. Note that this coding adds no explanatory power the conviction record does not already carry — its value is comparability across the dataset.

detection_delay_factors.value: Offences spanned six states with no shared records system. Contemporaneous investigative practice had no mechanism for linking homicides across jurisdictions; the case is one of the principal cited motivations for the creation of ViCAP in 1985.

method_now_disputed.value: Bite-mark comparison has since been found scientifically unreliable. The 2009 National Research Council report found no scientific basis for identifying an individual from bite marks; the 2016 PCAST report reached the same conclusion; the Texas Forensic Science Commission recommended a moratorium on its use in 2016. Multiple convictions resting on bite-mark testimony have been vacated.

sources.citation: National Research Council. Strengthening Forensic Science in the United States: A Path Forward. Washington DC: National Academies Press, 2009.

method_now_disputed.notes: This field exists because the inherited draft described this technique as having 'proven mathematically, to the millimetre'. It had not. Any dataset that reproduces historical forensic claims without their current standing is propagating discredited science. The claim sometimes made that this was the first US case in which bite-mark evidence secured a conviction is also not established — such evidence was admitted earlier, e.g. People v. Marx (Cal. Ct. App. 1975).

known_gaps: No agency-attributed victim count located; only the conviction count is established.
No documented psychometric assessment located; the circulating IQ figures are untraceable.
Childhood account rests on retrospective family recollection and offender self-report, not contemporaneous records.
Blood type, height and weight are asserted in secondary sources without a documented origin and are omitted entirely rather than recorded.
contested_points: The claim that Bundy was raised believing his mother to be his sister — plausible, widely repeated, not documented.
The claimed total of 30 victims — offender self-report under an incentive to delay execution.
Dorothy Otnow Lewis's pre-execution bipolar assessment — disputed by other clinicians.
Whether bite-mark evidence was decisive to the Chi Omega verdict, given the other evidence before the jury.
excluded_material: The 'physical type derived from a former girlfriend' theory of victim selection — durable in popular accounts, no evidentiary basis.
Victim counts in the 36-100 range — no traceable methodology.
Graphic description of offences against named victims — excluded under ETHICS.md as serving no analytic purpose.
Details drawn from film and television dramatisations — inadmissible at any tier under docs/sourcing-policy.md.
The narrative of ashes scattered in the Cascades — reported, but a private family matter with no analytic value; omitted.
